spec.description: The X5v75 evil coast with 50 dwarves in an underground shelter (user 13 Oct: dig a shelter, move everything inside with stockpiles, deconstruct the wagon, set a meeting place inside): scripts/shelter.sh on V75_EVIL50 -- a 9x9 room 4 levels down (93,92 stair, room z 125), an all-category stockpile and the meeting area over it, wagon deconstructed; after 6,000 ticks all 50 citizens were in the room and none outdoors. Infernal ash zombified every dwarf caught outdoors on V75_EVIL and V75_EVIL50. Runs on the walker fix (sw bebb00d) and the land pause (user 13 Oct). X5v75e3 stopped at tick 144,600 on a rig save flake (a stray 'w' in the save name), fort alive past the summer ash; its 86k ticks PASS. Same rules, receipts and length as X5v75.
